entries.title: I Timothy 1:1
segments: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the command of God our Savior, and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ, our hope,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:2
segments: to Timothy, [my] own son in [the] faith. Grace, mercy and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:3
segments: Even as I begged you to remain at Ephesus, when I was going to Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:4
segments: nor to give heed to fables and endless genealogies (which provide doubts rather than a stewardship of God in faith).

entries.title: I Timothy 1:5
segments: But the end of the commandment is love out of a pure heart, and a good conscience, and faith unfeigned,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:6
segments: from which some, having swerved, have turned aside to foolish talking,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:7
segments: desiring to be teachers of the law, neither understanding what they say nor that which they affirm.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:8
segments: But we know that the law [is] good if a man uses it lawfully,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:9
segments: knowing this, that the law [is] not made for a righteous one, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:10
segments: for fornicators, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and anything else that is contrary to sound doctrine,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:11
segments: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:12
segments: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who strengthened me, because He counted me faithful, putting [me] into the ministry--

entries.title: I Timothy 1:13
segments: the [one] who before was a blasphemer and a persecutor and insolent. But I obtained mercy, because being ignorant, I did [it] in unbelief.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:14
segments: [And] the grace of our Lord was exceedingly abundant, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:15
segments: Faithful [is] the Word and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:16
segments: But for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all long-suffering, as a pattern to those being about to believe on Him to life everlasting.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:17
segments: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, [the] only wise God, [be] honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:18
segments: This charge I commit to you, [my] son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before [about] you, in order that you might war a good warfare by them,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:19
segments: holding faith and a good conscience, which some have put away and made shipwreck as to faith.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:20
segments: Among these are Hymeneus and Alexander, whom I have delivered to Satan so that they may learn not to blaspheme.
